subject: Re: Redwood Inference - EnterpriseCorp buying process & exceptions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@enterprisecorp.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@enterprisecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference - buying process & next steps

Hi Jordan / Mike - thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Economic buyer: Jordan indicated CFO Mike Chen is the final approver.
- Procurement asks: EnterpriseCorp requires a vendor procurement review and prefers Net45 payment terms; they also asked about a potential SLA deviation for availability to meet their internal vendor rules.
- Decision criteria: reliability (99.9 target), predictable unit economics for embeddings/generation, and security/compliance (SOC2 + on-prem option).

Action items: 
1) Jordan/Mike: please share any procurement policy docs and your expected timeline for approvals.
2) Internal (Aditya + Neha + Marcus): I expect we may need two exceptions to standard T&Cs - payment Net45 (vs Net30) and a temporary SLA deviation to 99.5% for this initial committed term. Can you confirm process/owners for approval?

I attached the discovery notes and our standard SOW draft. I also started a HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Thanks - happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@enterprisecorp.com>

Cc: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - buying process & next steps

Thanks Marissa - good session. A few clarifications from procurement/ops: 

- Confirming economic buyer = Mike Chen (CFO).
- Procurement note: our master agreement review typically requires Net45 payment terms for new vendors; we can discuss a transitional model but procurement will flag Net30 as an exception.
- SLA: procurement/legal have a standard risk threshold that pushes vendor SLAs to 99.5% unless there is strong justification for 99.9. They asked if Redwood can sign 99.5 for the initial 12-month term.

I attached the procurement policy matrix for reference (EPC_MA_Policy.xlsx). Timeline: procurement review starts next Tuesday; target to complete in 2\u20133 weeks if the vendor exceptions are documented.

Jordan
Procurement Lead | EnterpriseCorp
jordan.price@enterprisecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Redwood Inference - buying process & next steps

Internal - forwarding procurement asks from EnterpriseCorp. Key asks: Net45 payment terms and SLA of 99.5% for initial term. They sign quickly if we can approve these exceptions plus a commercial concession. Proposed commercial approach:

- Offer: 20% first-year discount on hosted API usage in exchange for a 12-month committed reserved capacity (min $150k ARR).
- Payment: allow Net45 for this deal only (subject to finance approval & credit check).
- SLA: approve 99.5% for the initial 12 months with the Redwood SLA deviation form completed and an addendum on change-control for escalation to 99.9 for renewal.

Please advise on approval workflows and limits: Aditya - discount authority? Marcus - finance OK with Net45 for strategic accounts? Neha - legal review and signoff on SLA deviation (I attached the deviation form to expedite).

Attachment: Redwood_SLA_Deviation_Form.pdf

Thanks - need a quick internal decision to meet their procurement timeline.

Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood Inference - Redwood Inference - buying process & next steps

Marissa - I can approve up to 15% discount without escalation. For 20% I need a brief justification to present to VP of Sales (strategic account, good footprint for APAC expansion).

Marcus - please advise on Net45; if finance is comfortable, I can push 20% and sign off.

Neha - please review the SLA deviation form and flag any unacceptable legal exposures.

- Aditya
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - approval for Net45 (EnterpriseCorp)

Can support Net45 for EnterpriseCorp given the strategic nature and expected committed spend, but require: 
1) Completed credit check (Sales Ops to initiate).
2) Include a 60-day payment review clause for first year if utilization spikes beyond projections.
3) Finance to reserve right to request a 30% prepayment if credit metrics are weak.

If Sales confirms the forecast and credit check looks normal, Marcus approves Net45.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - buying process & next steps (approvals)

Jordan / EnterpriseCorp / team - internal approvals complete: 

- Legal approves the SLA deviation to 99.5% for the initial 12-month term, subject to the Redwood_SLA_Deviation_Form.pdf being attached to the contract and an indemnity/termination clause limited to material service breaches.
- Finance (Marcus) conditionally approves Net45 pending a standard credit check; Sales to confirm forecast.
- Sales (Aditya) has approved escalation to 20% discount for this strategic account (VP briefed).

Next steps for EnterpriseCorp: please confirm you accept the following so we can circulate the contract addendum and DocuSign link: 
1) 12-month commitment at agreed reserved capacity (min $150k ARR)
2) 20% first-year discount applied to hosted API consumption and reserved capacity line items
3) Payment terms Net45 (subject to credit check)
4) SLA at 99.5% for initial 12 months, with renewal evaluation and path to 99.9%

Once EnterpriseCorp confirms, we will attach the signed deviation form and send the contract for signature.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
